description:
If you enjoyed this episode you'll definitely enjoy our chat with Karren Brady https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cwPKlERwcGk&t=21s&pp=ygUMa2FycmVuIGJyYWR5  

In this new episode, Steven sits down with fashion guru and CEO, Trinny Woodall.
